verdict.rationale: Otter's own launch blog claims 'fully customizable' AI meeting summaries that extract insights based on meeting purpose and functional role (e.g. sales). That directly addresses shaping notes per meeting type, but it rests on a single marketing statement with no detail on how templates or prompts are created, saved or applied. Missing for 10: documented custom template or saved-prompt creation, per-meeting-type assignment (discovery call, 1:1, standup), detailed product docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: Otter's fully customizable, AI-powered meeting summaries automatically extract actionable insights based on meeting purpose and for different functional roles, such as sales, recruiters, project managers
